record.one_liner: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) for sending and receiving WhatsApp messages from a business phone number.
record.auth_notes: critic: added oauth2. Direct developers use a static System User access token (api_key). Tech Providers/partners onboard customers via Embedded Signup (Facebook Login for Businesses) and exchange the returned code for a Business Integration System User token; User access tokens are also supported.
record.access_notes: Developers get a test phone number and can send test messages with a system user token before any production approval. Production use requires a business portfolio and possibly App Review; captured in verdict. critic: access confirmed.
record.api_notes: Cloud API (Graph API, v23.0 in examples), Marketing Messages API and Business Management API are documented on the platform overview.
record.blocker_notes: Test-number sandbox works self-serve. Production messaging needs business verification and App Review where the use case requires it. critic: mcp official confirmed (endpoint https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools, beta, Meta developer account OAuth sign-in).

evidence.quote: If you are a direct developer, meaning only you or your business accesses your own data, use a System User access token.

To generate a Business Integration System User access token, you must implement Embedded Signup (configured with Facebook Login for Businesses) and exchange the code returned to you when a customer completes the flow.
